caption: The drawing features a central heart-shaped area containing German text written in dark ink. Surrounding the heart, the composition includes various plants, flowers, and four stylized birds. Two birds, with bodies in shades of green and brown, wing and tail feathers in blue-green, black and white eyes, and yellow beaks, are perched near the top corners, each sitting on a leafy branch. The other two birds are positioned near the bottom corners, each with a yellowish-green, brown, and pinkish body, black eyes, blue wings, and pink-tipped tails. The floral motifs are colored with pink, yellow, red, and green, with leaves predominantly green, some featuring lighter or blue-green hues. The background is off-white, and the decorative border is framed with leafy branches and flowers, creating a symmetrical and balanced layout around the central heart. The artwork is rendered in watercolor and ink, giving it a soft and pastel color palette.
title: Illuminated Psalm
